title: Multiplying Fractions
hook: Imagine using multiplying fractions to solve a puzzle in Fraction Forest.
bigIdea: Multiplying Fractions helps you describe and solve number relationships. Choose the operation that matches the question, keep track of units, and check that your answer makes sense.

realWorld: People use multiplying fractions when measuring, comparing, planning, and checking quantities in everyday tasks.
